messages.content: 你能計算我進行的科學實驗中空氣在恆壓下的熱容量嗎？我有一個容積為2.5立方公尺的容器，並能保持溫度在300開氏度。我將在更高的溫度350開氏度重複這個實驗，接下來在更低的容積1.5立方公尺下一樣重複這個實驗。我在所有這些實驗中都使用空氣。你能提供這三種不同條件下的熱容量嗎？

function.name: calc_heat_capacity
function.description: Calculate the heat capacity at constant pressure of air using its temperature and volume. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

temp.description: The temperature of the gas in Kelvin.

volume.description: The volume of the gas in m^3. This is a float type value.

gas.description: Type of gas, with air as default.

message.reasoning:
We need to use the tool to calculate heat capacity. The user wants three different conditions: 1) volume 2.5 m^3, temp 300 K; 2) same volume 2.5 m^3, temp 350 K; 3) volume 1.5 m^3, temp 350 K? Wait: "接下來在更低的容積1.5立方公尺下一樣重複這個實驗" means next lower volume 1.5 m^3 repeat experiment. But earlier they said "我將在更高的溫度350開氏度重複這個實驗". So sequence: first 2.5 m^3 at 300 K; second 2.5 m^3 at 350 K; third 1.5 m^3 at 350 K? Or maybe third 1.5 m^3 at 300 K? The phrase "接下來在更低的容積1.5立方公尺下一樣重複這個實驗" could mean after the higher temperature experiment, they will repeat the experiment at lower volume 1.5 m^3 (presumably at the same higher temperature 350 K). So third condition: volume 1.5 m^3, temp 350 K. They didn't mention repeating at 300 K with lower volume. So we assume third: 1.5 m^3, 350 K.

We need to call the tool thrice. Use the function calls.
